name: Lightning Gland
summary: Across the Barrens, stormhides carry Lightning Glands that Brewmaster Drohn needs in Ratchet. Chen Stormstout taught Drohn to make trogg ale, a fiery brew.

sections.title: A Shocking Ingredient
sections.body: Stormhides roam the Barrens savannas among other predators touched by the elements. Their flesh holds Lightning Glands charged with latent electricity. The glands make poor fare on their own, but brewers prize the sting they bring to a brew.

sections.title: Drohn's Trogg Ale
sections.body: In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn keeps Chen Stormstout’s brewing traditions alive. For trogg ale, a potent brew, he needs five Lightning Glands, a thunderhawk saliva gland, and a fresh kodo liver. The finished drink has a sharp kick that adventurers find invigorating and potent.

faq.answer: Stormhides roaming the Barrens savannas carry Lightning Glands.

faq.q: Who wants lightning glands and why?
faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet wants Lightning Glands for trogg ale. Chen Stormstout, the wandering brewmaster, taught him the recipe.

faq.q: What else is needed alongside the lightning gland?
faq.answer: Drohn needs five Lightning Glands, a thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a fresh kodo liver from the beasts of the Barrens.

angles.text: As a cook, you can see how Brewmaster Drohn and Chen Stormstout use raw beast organs in spirits. Lightning Glands are not ordinary food.
